W2.stud_designation: 362S125-xx per 'INTERIOR WALL LIMITING HEIGHTS' (A2.0), 5 PSF, L/240. Neither the type nor the plan prints the thickness/spacing, so the row DEPENDS ON HEIGHT and spacing. Wall height used: 12'-6" = retail ceiling 12'-0" AFF (A3.0 tag 'NEW GRID AND TILES 2x4 ACT 12'-0" AFF'; A4.0 room finish schedule 100 RETAIL ceiling height 12'-0") + 6" (type text 'FROM SLAB TO 6" ABOVE CEILING') [DERIVED: 12.0+0.5=12.5 ft]. Rows that qualify at 12'-6": @16" o.c.: 362S125-27 (15'-0"), -30 (15'-6"), -33 (16'-0"), -43 (17'-5"); 362S125-18 @16" = 12'-2" < 12'-6" FAILS (only 362S125-18 @12" = 14'-0" works). @24" o.c.: 362S125-27 (13'-1") minimum. Lightest at 16" o.c. = 362S125-27; if the 20 GA min. from 4/A2.0 brace note governs (20 GA = 33 mil), row = 362S125-33 @16" o.c. (16'-0" >= 12'-6"). Storage side alone would be 10'-6" (10'-0" ACT +6") where 362S125-18 @16" (12'-2") would pass.
